description: Carte des parcs éoliens présents sur le Pays de Bitche (2015) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.gouv.fr. Donnée au format shapefile des parcs éoliens situé sur le Pays de Bitche. Ces données sont distribuées par l'Open Data français. Les données ont été redécoupées sur l'emprise de la communauté de communes du Pays de Bitche. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include Energie renouvellable, 2018.0, DRIIHM - INEE - CNRS, Pays de Bitche, Energie, OHM Pays de Bitche. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
